label: Status enquiry
examples: What is the strata title status? When will my title be transferred?

label: Progress update
examples: Asking for an update on how the file is progressing, or giving one.

label: Complaint
examples: Complaint about the PIC, delayed response, unable to reach the PIC, no update, documents released or sent wrongly.

label: Payment
examples: How much needs to be paid, how to pay, which account to pay into.

label: Collection
examples: Collecting the MOT, clearance letter, NOA.

label: Request for PIC contact
examples: Asking for the PIC's email address, office or handphone number, or the department HOD.

label: Others
examples: Change of correspondence address, repeated calls just to speak with the PIC, anything else.
